kind: Duranki Addendum A packet verification and disposition-02 document checks
scope: Data-only hashing, document comparison, bounded file discovery, and new review-note authoring; no application execution

historical_reconstruction.word_count_note: Different convention possible; reported count not reproduced. Current hashes and bytes match.

dependency_discovery.limitation: Not a claim that the files do not exist; no underlying citation verification or private-cloud search claimed.

owner_decisions.basis: Owner-supplied handoff section 4 quoting 23 October 2026 reply; not an independently retrieved original transcript

test_crosswalk.title: Shared-field presence and absence reasons
test_crosswalk.required_outcome: Reject invalid new-profile record shapes; do not reinterpret or invalidate legacy rows. A reason code does not waive required authority.

test_crosswalk.title: Trusted delegation endpoints and reported intermediate links
test_crosswalk.required_outcome: Reject forged authority-bearing endpoints; retain unverified intermediate links only as attributed assertions; test direct-human and autonomous cases.

test_crosswalk.title: Record-only commission references
test_crosswalk.required_outcome: An asserted reference neither grants nor denies execution by commission authority before that authority is enabled; syntax/size/handling checks still apply.

test_crosswalk.title: Integrated non-text provider-egress containment
test_crosswalk.required_outcome: A working authorized path succeeds; direct forbidden application/worker paths to that endpoint fail and alert. No whole-platform claim from a local probe.

test_crosswalk.title: Search-query handling and destination permission
test_crosswalk.required_outcome: Disallowed query handling rejects before send; provenance and restrictions survive returned search data.

test_crosswalk.title: Session reservation-extension failure
test_crosswalk.required_outcome: Prevent further unauthorized release under the proved bound, request/observe stop, and retain uncertain exposure; local closure does not settle the session.

test_crosswalk.title: Realtime content exclusion from telemetry
test_crosswalk.required_outcome: Prohibited complete response content reaches no diagnostic callback, exception log, export buffer or sink; permitted accounting metadata remains available.

test_crosswalk.title: Missing native-operation usage
test_crosswalk.required_outcome: Missing/null/invalid required usage leaves cost unknown and relevant exposure held; separate estimates do not settle it; later evidence appends once.

test_crosswalk.title: Commission revocation after commitment before first write
test_crosswalk.required_outcome: Effective scoped revocation blocks queued unsent work at the qualified first-write boundary; a check before a lower wait is insufficient.

test_crosswalk.title: Commission revocation during a session
test_crosswalk.required_outcome: Stop further unauthorized release within a qualified bound; preserve committed/in-flight exposure and distinguish local close from provider-confirmed stop and settlement.

test_crosswalk.title: Stale activation fencing at request and acceptance
test_crosswalk.required_outcome: Reject unauthorized activation at admission and first-write freshness; orchestrator rejects stale acceptance. Retain late usage/liability evidence. No new effect or budget merely from activation change.
